name: Summit AZ - Garbage Disposal City Pages
body:
> Plan · Summit Az · 2026-09-25

# Summary
Rewrite drafts for two garbage disposal city pages that Google had discovered but never crawled. Both were near-copies of the Scottsdale disposal page. Applied live Sep 24 to 25 (handoff and case study).

# Pages
| City | Page ID | Draft file | Before | Main keyword | New title |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Phoenix | 10191 | `Summit-AZ-Garbage-Disposal-Phoenix-Draft-2026-09-25.md` | 33% identical, 41% near-identical to Scottsdale | garbage disposal plumber (1,300 / KD 30) | Garbage Disposal Plumber in Phoenix, AZ \| Summit |
| Fountain Hills | 10188 | `Summit-AZ-Garbage-Disposal-Fountain-Hills-Draft-2026-09-25.md` | 19% identical, 46% near-identical | garbage disposal leaking (4,400 / KD 17) | Garbage Disposal Leaking? Fountain Hills Repair \| Summit |

# Supporting keywords
- Phoenix: garbage disposal not working (22,200), reset button (12,100), leaking from bottom (8,100), humming (3,600), how long do garbage disposals last (2,900), horsepower (320). This gave Phoenix a different primary from the other 9 disposal pages.
- Fountain Hills: batch feed garbage disposal (1,000), backing up (590), backing up into other sink (260), continuous vs batch feed (140).

# Fixes
- Removed pasted chat-app code blocks, "often the same day", "haul away the old unit", "never a forced upsell", the made-up term "tank-feed" and an unconfirmed EPCOR claim.
- Phoenix focus keyword box cut from 8 terms (including the brand) to 5 relevant terms.
- Camera filename alt text ("Dsc03489") replaced on the widget, since the media entries no longer exist.
- Fountain Hills copy built on Fountain Hills Sanitary District backup guidance.
